rules: Finite two-period acyclic mechanism, independent initial innovations; no unmodelled infinite past
Rows are independent episodes; unrolled node columns use LPCMCI at tau_max=0, without claiming stationary temporal equivalence
Oracle maximal ancestral target joins pairs with no observed separating set; tails indicate ancestry in the full DAG
Score adjacency and correctness/informativeness of definite endpoint claims; circles abstain; do not equate one MAG with its PAG
Include hidden-confounded front-door identified query and explicit nonidentification witness for a confounded direct action-outcome query

truth.scope: Finite observed margin, no selection variables. Oracle MAG of supplied DAG, not its PAG equivalence class.

score.scope: Empirical soundness relative to generating ancestry; no assertion of orientation completeness or graph confidence.
